summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, containing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement that sets the date for its board meeting and results publication for Q2 and first half of 2026. The board will meet on August 20, 2026, to approve the unaudited results, with an announcement and earnings call scheduled that day. This is a routine procedural filing in advance of scheduled earnings, not a special situation such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, or restructuring. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is involved; it is purely a notification of the earnings calendar.
